matrix_role: Reusable tests for bodies that have formal authority language, meetings, mission, dashboards, money, or public blame / credit, but may not control the operative levers for the outcome they are said to govern.

attribution_boundary.fail_or_repair: Move the claim to hypothesis or diagnosis status, add source-currentness, and block credit / blame from hardening into doctrine.
attribution_boundary.label: Attribution-boundary test
attribution_boundary.question: Are success and failure claims attributed only to lanes that the evidence can support?

contract_traceability.fail_or_repair: Block performance or stewardship claims until the contract file can prove what was paid, delivered, verified, corrected, and closed.
contract_traceability.label: Contract-traceability test
contract_traceability.question: Can payments, advances, deliverables, monitoring, corrective action, and closeout be reconstructed for provider-delivered services?

data_reality.fail_or_repair: Label the data as incomplete or unverified, repair source systems, and block attribution claims that the data cannot carry.
data_reality.label: Data-reality test
data_reality.question: Can dashboards, counts, utilization claims, and outcome claims be replayed from source records with data-quality limits visible?

mandate_owner_boundary.fail_or_repair: Narrow public claims, publish the owner map, or recharter the body before assigning success or failure.
mandate_owner_boundary.label: Mandate-owner boundary test
mandate_owner_boundary.question: Does the body legally own the outcome, or only coordinate, administer, contract, report, or convene part of it?

principal_accountability.fail_or_repair: Publish retained-principal responsibilities and block blame-shifting before using the joint body as the accountability target.
principal_accountability.label: Principal-accountability test
principal_accountability.question: Are elected, fiscal, legal, land-use, health, or enforcement principals prevented from hiding their choices behind the visible joint body?

provider_dependence.fail_or_repair: Separate provider performance from authority performance and repair monitoring, payment, or capacity before judging the whole waist.
provider_dependence.label: Provider-dependence test
provider_dependence.question: Does the body rely on nonprofit, private, or intergovernmental providers whose capacity and failures need their own record instead of being merged into the body?

resource_control.fail_or_repair: Separate direct authority from influence; add resources, lower the mandate, or move the function to an actor with the levers.
resource_control.label: Resource-control test
resource_control.question: Do money, staff, land, systems, provider capacity, and operating discretion match the public mandate?

service_pathway.fail_or_repair: Treat the system as not yet accountable to users; publish a pathway map and preserve service records before claiming delivery success.
service_pathway.label: Service-pathway test
service_pathway.question: Can a person, provider, reviewer, or auditor trace the real service path from intake to referral, placement, case management, exit, and complaint?

sunset_recharter_choice.fail_or_repair: Force a public choice among retain, shrink, split, recharter, absorb, or sunset, with evidence and transition terms for each.
sunset_recharter_choice.label: Sunset, shrink, split, or recharter choice test
sunset_recharter_choice.question: Does the docket support abolition, retention, shrinking, splitting, departmental absorption, or recharter with reasons rather than frustration alone?

transition_receipt.fail_or_repair: Do not treat reorganization as repair; publish the transition receipt and keep the old and new accountability lanes linked.
transition_receipt.label: Transition-receipt test
transition_receipt.question: Does reorganization, bypass, absorption, defunding, or recharter carry a receipt for records, staff, contracts, funds, grants, users, dashboards, obligations, and residual functions?
